title: Graceful fallback & reservation conversion GTM template for new regional instance families
creator: Ava Chen
description: Create and coordinate a single GTM template that combines: (1) a consumer-friendly reservation conversion path for customers who have older fixed reservations, (2) a graceful fallback routing policy for new APAC edge instance family launches, and (3) a canonical release-notes + downstream comms template for Console, API, and Marketplace. This ticket covers cross-team checkpoints, sales enablement artifacts, support runbooks, and the final sign-off checklist.
goal: Minimize customer disruption during new instance family launches while giving Sales/Support a clear, low-friction path to migrate/reserve capacity. Ensure release notes and product comms are consistent across Console, API docs, and partner marketplaces.
acceptance_criteria: A single GTM template exists and is stored in Confluence: 'GTM / Dedicated / Regional Instance Launches / conversion-and-fallback-template'.
Release notes draft covering API changes, reservation SKU mapping, and known limitations published to the draft channel and linked in the ticket.
Sales enablement deck (PDF) and migration playbook delivered to Sales Engineering and validated by at least 2 SEs.
Support runbook (step-by-step triage + escalation) uploaded to internal KB and read by Support on-call with acknowledgment.
Fallback routing policy tests executed in staging with 95th percentile latency and correctness checks; results attached.
All cross-team dependencies (infra, console, billing, docs) assigned with clear owners and timelines.

comments: 2026-02-21 - Ava Chen: Kickoff complete. Draft GTM template created in Confluence. Assigned engineers for fallback router prototype. Asked Billing for SKU mapping by Feb 27.

2026-02-26 - Min-Jae Park: Prototype for fallback routing merged to staging branch. Initial tests show correct model fallbacks but KV-cache warmup latency spike ~120ms on cold starts. Engineering recommends a warmed-delta rollout and a short-lived cache prefill job during migration windows.

2026-03-01 - Priya Raman: Sales prefers a conversion path that minimizes customer-visible billing changes. Proposed 'auto-credits' for customers who convert within first 30 days. Finance needs estimates.
2026-03-03 - Lina Kovac: UX mock updated to include 'preview cost delta' modal. DES reviewed; accessibility pass requested. PR: github.com/redwood/console/pull/1482
2026-03-05 - Omar Saliba: Support runbook draft added. Need explicit error codes mapping from Eng for 'reservation mismatch' scenarios.
2026-03-08 - Ava Chen: Coordinated tentative launch window 2026-03-20; marketing to confirm announcement timing. War room owners assigned.
2026-03-10 - Min-Jae Park: Staging run completed. Latency regressions mitigated after prefill job. Adding fallback policy toggle for canary first - ENG-30012 added as follow-up.
2026-03-11 - Priya Raman: SEs approved the migration cheat sheet after modifications. Two SEs volunteered for shadow calls during first 48 hours post-launch.
decision_log: 2026-02-25 - Decision: Use a phased canary rollout for APAC edge instance families with fallback routing enabled by default for canary traffic. Rationale: reduce blast radius and validate SKU mapping in real traffic.
2026-03-02 - Decision: Implement cache prefill during migration windows to address cold-start latency for KV-heavy workloads. Rationale: prevents customer-visible latency spikes and minimizes aborts.

2026-03-07 - Decision: Offer a 30-day credit for customers who convert reservations within the grace period. Rationale: lowers friction for customers to move to new flexible tiers; Finance approved a cap.
2026-03-09 - Decision: Release notes will include explicit API examples for conversions and example CLI commands for SEs. Rationale: reduces inbound support tickets and enables self-serve migration.
rollout_timeline: 2026-03-12: Finalize release notes and SE deck. Dry run war room procedures.
2026-03-15: Docs freeze. Billing to finalize SKU mapping and update API schema.
2026-03-18: Internal-only canary (5% traffic) to validate routing + migration UX.
2026-03-20: Gradual regional ramp to 50% over 6 hours with active monitoring and SE shadow calls.
2026-03-22: Full rollout subject to metrics and support load.
Post-launch (2026-03-23 to 2026-04-06): Monitoring window and follow-up retrospective.
post_launch_metrics: Reservation conversion rate (daily) - target >= 60% for customers offered auto-credit
Support tickets related to reservation conversion - target < 10/day in first week
95th percentile token-generation latency for APAC edge - no more than +30ms over baseline
Billing reconciliation discrepancies - target 0 unresolved >72 hours
notes: Follow-up tickets expected for: 1) finer-grain telemetry around fallback routing (ENG-30012), 2) a post-launch UX polish for the conversion modal (DES-429), and 3) a billing API filter to support 'grace credit' tagging. Ensure Marketing and Legal review the announcement copy before publish.
